title: White Bean and Kale Soup
seoTitle: White Bean and Kale Soup | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Tuscan-style cannellini soup with garlic, rosemary, and parmesan rind
subtitle: Tuscan-style cannellini soup with garlic, rosemary, and parmesan rind
description: Cannellini beans simmer with kale, garlic, rosemary, and parmesan rind into a thick, rustic soup. Blend partial batch for creamy body.

steps.title: Sweat mirepoix
steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in an 8-quart pot over medium. Cook onion, carrot, and celery 8 minutes until softened and onion turns translucent at edges.

steps.title: Add garlic and tomatoes
steps.instruction: Stir in garlic, cook 1 minute until fragrant. Add crushed tomatoes and cook 3 minutes until color deepens slightly and raw tomato smell fades.

steps.title: Simmer beans and broth
steps.instruction: Add 3 cans beans, broth, rosemary, and parmesan rind. Simmer 20 minutes so flavors meld and broth reduces slightly.

steps.title: Blend partial batch
steps.instruction: Blend 1 can beans with 1 cup soup until smooth. Return to pot for creamy body without heavy cream.

steps.title: Wilt kale and serve
steps.instruction: Stir in kale, simmer 5 minutes until tender-bright green. Soup should coat a spoon; adjust salt before ladle service.

proTips: Parmesan rind is free flavor—never throw them away.
Crusty bread for dipping turns this into a full hall meal.
Red pepper flakes at the line add heat without changing the pot.
tonightSpread: Shaved parmesan and olive oil drizzle.
leftovers: Thickens overnight—thin with broth when reheating.
Freeze quart portions for backup vegetarian nights.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Vegetarian main that still fills up firefighters. Cheap, hearty, and holds well on the back burner.
mealPrepNotes: Save parmesan rinds in the freezer for soup weeks. Chop kale day-of so it stays green. Station: Blend one can of beans for body without adding cream. Station: Add kale last 5 minutes—longer cooking turns it bitter and drab. Station: Serve with parmesan and olive oil drizzle at the line.
